question.text: Which of the following items belongs in the 'Impact Score Card' section (not 'Approach' or 'Strategic Intent and Planning') of the Annual Impact Report under SEBI's framework?

answer.text: Baseline status and situation analysis at the start of the intervention.
Beneficiary / Stakeholder Validation through surveys and feedback mechanisms.
The social or environmental challenge the organisation is addressing.
Alignment of solutions to Sustainable Development Goals / national priorities.

explanation.text: The Logic: Impact Score Card covers: metrics monitored and trend, narratives of impact on target segment, and Beneficiary/Stakeholder Validation via surveys and feedback. Baseline status and SDG alignment fall under 'Approach'; the challenge description falls under 'Strategic Intent and Planning'. The Trap: Each distractor is a real AIR item but assigned to the wrong section - baseline goes in Approach, SDG alignment goes in Approach, challenge description goes in Strategic Intent. Correct section-mapping is the test. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII Topic 1 SDG mapping and Topic 8 Case Study both cross-test AIR section assignment. Also tested under III-A/III-C for general SSE disclosure literacy. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Build a three-column working paper (Strategic Intent | Approach | Impact Score Card) and paste every AIR draft paragraph into the right cell before review. Mis-classified paragraphs dilute scoring clarity and invite SSE to reject the AIR on format grounds.
